body:
Add `.mch` machine definitions under `assets/machines/` for the **Laguna Swift** and **Grizzly RichAuto A11** CNC router lines, plus the friend's confirmed model from #1907.

## Scope

Follow `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md` and existing router definitions (`assets/machines/sienci-altmill-4x4.mch`, `assets/machines/tormach-24r.mch`):
- **Laguna Swift line:** `Swift 4x4`, `Swift 4x8`, `Swift 5x10` (3 HP liquid-cooled spindle, 6,000-24,000 RPM, ER20, rapid up to 900 IPM, cut feed 400-600 IPM, manual tool change). Confirm exact Z travel (`~6"-7.5"` across model years) from OEM manual revisions.
- **Grizzly RichAuto A11 line:**
  - `G0894` (35-3/8" x 23-5/8" x 5" Z, ~396 IPM X/Y, ~192 IPM Z, 3 HP 6,000-24,000 RPM, ER20)
  - `G0931` / `G0931L` (47-1/4" x 47-1/4" x 6-1/4" to 7-7/8" Z per manual revision, ~708-709 IPM X/Y, ~394-396 IPM Z, 3 HP 0-24,000 RPM stated, ER20)
  - `G0895` (51" x 98-1/2" x 11" Z travel / 7" clearance, 1,500 IPM X/Y rapid, 400 IPM Z, 6 HP 6,000-18,000 RPM, ER32)
- **Friend's machine:** add or match the exact model once mkinney confirms make, model, table size, Z travel, and spindle limits on #1907.

## Dependencies and notes

- Depends on the RichAuto DSP A11 post issue so `default_post_for` in `crates/app/src/posting.rs` maps these machines to `RichAuto DSP A11`.
- Set `general.vendor` to `"Camcraft"`, omit JSON comments, set `safe_retract` in machine coordinates (`0.0` at top Z limit), and omit or verify `rigid_tapping` against OEM sources (`docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md`).
- Clean room: cite only public Laguna Tools and Grizzly manuals and spec sheets.

## Done means

- Each target machine `.mch` file passes validation under `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs`.
- Every new file is registered in `MACHINES` and `default_post_for` in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`.
- `crates/app/tests/machine.rs` and dedicated router spec tests check and pass every new machine entry.

Part of #1907
